description: Critical positions from the v14 fast loop (iteration 1, vs v0). Each is a verified losing move and the oracle-verified saving move instead (see research/iterations/iter-14.md §2). No patch was made: iteration 1 found no new patchable weakness class, so all three are documented xfails — open weaknesses for the next batch.

positions.note: White to move, Black holds exactly 2 creators: (5,6) and (9,6). BOTH are blocks that kill all Black creators; v1 scores within 62 points (200169 vs 200107). Oracle: (9,6) loses 3/3, (5,6) draws 3/3. Both the v0 and v1 gradients prefer the losing block (+0.061/+0.121 vs +0.025/+0.046), and v7 plays it too — no signal in the engine separates the two blocks. Not patchable within the leaf design.

White to move, Black holds exactly 2 creators: (6,5) and (6,9). BOTH are blocks that kill all Black creators; v1 scores within 1920 points (204087 vs 200167). Oracle: (6,9) loses 3/3, (6,5) draws 3/3. Both gradients prefer the losing block (+0.119/+0.174 vs +0.072/+0.146); v7 plays it too. Same class as fl1-g1-ply9.

White to move, quiet position (Black holds 0 creators). The saving move (4,6) is v1 rank 6 (prior 0.044) and wins 3/3 by oracle; the played (5,10) is v1 rank 1 and loses 3/3. The v1 gradient PREFERS the save (+0.064 vs +0.046) — the leaf is right — but the search starves it (3 visits vs 15) and its q is noisy (-0.060). Exploration weakness, same class as v7 fl1-g3-ply23; no leaf patch fixes it.
